title: Blockchain101
tagline: A blockchain info hub that simplifies decentralized tech. Our website simplifies blockchain, crypto, NFTs, and DeFi concepts for beginners.
description:
Our blockchain information HTML website is a work in progress, steadily evolving as we build out its features and content. We're currently focused on developing the foundation, including creating  educational materials. The goal is to make blockchain technology accessible and understandable to everyone, but we recognize that achieving this requires continuous effort and adaptation in an ever-changing field.

So far, we've made progress in developing beginner guides on blockchain basics, cryptocurrencies, and NFTs. These initial resources are being refined based on user feedback, and we're planning to expand into more advanced topics soon and incorporate interactive tools.
how_its_made:
Our blockchain information website was built using HTML, focusing on simplicity and accessibility. The idea was to create a straightforward platform that could effectively communicate complex blockchain concepts to a broad audience. HTML was chosen for its ease of use and ability to quickly set up a functional, static site without requiring a complex backend.

Initially, we had plans to integrate more advanced features, such as a trained chatbot that users could interact with to learn about blockchain topics. We also wanted to incorporate a Worldcoin sign-in API to enhance user authentication and security. However, due to time constraints, we couldn't implement these features.
